convention:
Exact emanation-table and left-multiplication references. Standard library only.

Convention: (a,b)(c,d)=(ac-conj(d)b, da+b conj(c)); e_p e_q=s(p,q)e_(p xor q).
ET signs are the numerical signs in strutted_et.rs, not de Marrais's named
positive/negative edge convention. An occupied cell of numerical sign eta
annihilates right-dyad sign tau=-eta when the left-dyad sign is +1.

This file has no account, network, or quantum hardware interface.

tables.sign_semantics: zero product iff sigma*tau=-eta on occupied cells
